unit.why: This is a letter (1876) from R. Yekutiel Yehuda Teitelbaum of Sighet to R. Israel, chiefly on halakhic and kabbalistic questions about tefillin. It embeds two short narrative episodes: the 'wondrous' arrival of a guest praying from the sought-for siddur, and the writer's eyewitness memory of R. Zvi of Rimanov wearing two pairs of tefillin in private.
unit.boundary_note: The letter begins with a heading continuing from the previous division and runs into the next division (homily on Rebecca / Eliezer).

stories.start_quote: והדבר פלא כי ביום וא"ו עש"ק העבר
stories.summary_en: Right after his correspondent cited a source in R. Shabbetai's siddur, a guest arrived in Sighet for Shabbat praying from that very siddur, so the rebbe could verify the source.

quotes: ביום וא"ו עש"ק העבר בא לכאן איש א׳ לשבת פה

tags.why: The guest prays from the siddur.

quotes: והדבר פלא כי ביום וא"ו עש"ק העבר

stories.start_quote: וזכורני בהיותי ק"ק רימינאב ראיתי את
stories.summary_en: The writer recalls seeing R. Zvi of Rimanov, even in old age, put on two pairs of tefillin together at home at dawn when few people were about, and then pray in the beit midrash in Rashi tefillin only; he cites this to advise his correspondent to keep the practice private.
